Accounts.title: Accounts
Accounts.body: The chart of accounts for this workspace, grouped into assets, liabilities, equity, revenue and expenses. Here you create and edit accounts and archive what is no longer needed. An account that carries postings can only be archived, never deleted: the history behind it stays complete. Below the chart you maintain the cost centres.
